4824-6006-7008.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

728-3249-5173-6006.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-5173-6006.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Enduring Vitality by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

339-677-728-4359.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

6034-6732-8089.easyPrerequisites: Pact Weapon attached to a creature you control.
6034-6732-8089.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is a multiple of 3.
6034-6732-8089.description:
Activate Souldrinker by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

252-3499-4231-5394.easyPrerequisites:
You control another artifact creature.
You have a way to kill the additional artifact creature.
252-3499-4231-5394.description:
Cause another artifact creature you control to die.
When the artifact creature dies, Nick Valentine triggers, creating a Clue, Food and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
As the Clue, Food and Treasure enter, they each become 7/7 Dinosaur artifact creatures in addition to their other types due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

1479-3257-3604.description:
Create a nonlegendary copy of Kodama of the East Tree using Cadric (this may involve additional steps depending on the card used).
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, both Kodama of the East Trees and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the legendary Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium onto the battlefield.
The nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the nonlegendary Kodama of the East Tree's trigger, putting Rakdos Carnarium onto the battlefield.
The legendary Kodama of the East Tree and Rakdos Carnarium trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

821-2092-2757-5140.description:
Activate a basic Swamp by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {B} due to Agatha, returning Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Mogg Fanatic, untapping the basic Swamp.
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

27-3259-6633.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
27-3259-6633.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Sun-Blessed Guardian // Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2539-3094-4659-7175-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2539-3094-4659-7175-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed twice due to Twinning Staff, targeting Lithoform Engine and another artifact card in your graveyard.
Resolve both copies of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine and the other artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the other artifact, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

3165-3532-5078-6709.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
3165-3532-5078-6709.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Managorger Hydra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5571-6797-6922--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
5571-6797-6922--6.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Blightbeetle and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3459-4499-6252.description:
Activate Boommobile's crew ability by tapping Battered Golem, causing Boommobile to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Boommobile.
When Boommobile enters the battlefield, it and Battered Golem trigger.
Resolve the Battered Golem trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Boommobile trigger, adding four mana of any color that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat

1062-5636-5674-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-5636-5674-5870.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3292-3892-4068.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
392-3292-3892-4068.description:
Cast Spear Spewer by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Spear Spewer by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each player.
Dissipation Field triggers, returning Spear Spewer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
392-3292-3892-4068.notes: It is recommended to perform this combo when you have more life than your opponents to end the game, but it is not required. If this combo will not end the game, stop once you have 1 life.

969-1308-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Ayara, Widow of the Realm // Ayara, Furnace Queen

1405-2923-5147.notablePrerequisites: An opponent's life total is higher than or equal to your life total.
1405-2923-5147.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Ayara triggers, returning Scourge of the Throne from your graveyard to the battlefield, and giving it haste until end of turn.
Declare Scourge of the Throne as an attacker, attacking an opponent whose life total is higher than or equal to yours.
Scourge of the Throne's dethrone ability and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger, causing you to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Scourge of the Throne, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the second Scourge of the Throne trigger from step 3, doing nothing.
Repeat each combat phase.

1621-4089.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Glasspool Mimic // Glasspool Shore.
1621-4089.description:
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Glasspool Mimic. Choose to have Glasspool Mimic enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

765-1479-1817.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1479-1817.description:
Cast Kodama of the East Tree either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{G}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Kodama of the East Tree spell, with the copy not being legendary.
Resolve both Kodama of the East Tree spells.
Play Guildless Commons.
Both Kodama of the East Trees and Guildless Commons trigger.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
The token Kodama of the East Tree and Guildless Commons trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree and Guildless Commons trigger.
Repeat from step 7.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3175-3680-4349.notablePrerequisites:
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
You have the highest life total.
670-1619-3175-3680-4349.description:
Cast Sun Titan by paying {4}{W}{W}.
When Sun Titan enters the battlefield, it, Radiant Solar and Stunt Double trigger.
Resolve the Sun Titan trigger, returning Fell Stinger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fell Stinger enters the battlefield, its exploit ability, Radiant Solar and Stunt Double trigger.
Resolve the Fell Stinger trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
Fell Stinger's second ability triggers, causing target player to draw 2 cards and lose 2 life.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger from step 4, causing you to venture into the "Trapped Entry" room of Tomb of Annihilation, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 4, causing you to venture into the "Veils of Fear" room, causing each player to discard a card or lose 2 life.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger from step 2, causing you to venture into the "Sandfall Cell" room, causing you to sacrifice Sun Titan and each opponent to either sacrifice a creature, artifact or land, or lose 2 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 2, causing you to venture into the "Cradle of the Death God" room, creating a legendary 4/4 The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1881-4929-5220.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Cryptic Trilobite enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Cryptic Trilobite on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

175-4178-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Avid Reclaimer.
Avid Reclaimer does not have summoning sickness.
175-4178-4222.description:
Activate Avid Reclaimer by tapping it, adding {U} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Avid Reclaimer.
Repeat.

3918-4740.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Trazyn the Infinite lifelink.
Your life total is at least 51.
3918-4740.description:
Give Trazyn the Infinite lifelink, if needed.
Activate Trazyn the Infinite using Aetherflux Reservoir's ability by paying 50 life, dealing 50 damage to any target and causing you to gain 50 life.
Repeat step 2.

38-659-1288.notablePrerequisites: You control a number of Goblins that is equal to or greater than six plus Krenko's commander tax.
38-659-1288.description:
Activate Krenko by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Goblin creature tokens equal to the number of Goblins you control.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing Krenko, adding {R}.
Choose to return Krenko to the command zone from your graveyard.
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you have enough mana to cast Krenko.
Cast Krenko from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{R} plus commander tax.
Repeat.

1952-2059-3542.notablePrerequisites:
Livio does not have summoning sickness.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{W}{W}{W}.
1952-2059-3542.description:
Activate up to seven mana-producing lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Livio's first ability twice by paying {2}{W}{W}, exiling Palinchron and Village Bell-Ringer with aegis counters on them.
Activate Livio's second ability by paying {2}{W} and tapping it, returning Palinchron and Village Bell-Ringer from exile to the battlefield.
Village Bell-Ringer and Palinchron enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Resolve the Village Bell-Ringer trigger, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

1462-1722-1758-2034.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1462-1722-1758-2034.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Eidolon of Blossoms.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Eidolon of Blossoms trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

643-1339-4219.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
643-1339-4219.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield with all creature types due to Maskwood Nexus, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
